description:
Available for the first time in nearly six decades, this fully detached corner residence seamlessly balances classic Marina prestige with generations of cherished family history. Oh, if these walls could talk they would tell a story of celebration, San Francisco history and an enduring love for home and family. Sunlight floods the upper level, illuminating newly refinished hardwood floors, fresh interior paint, and modern light fixtures. The expansive floor plan effortlessly accommodates both vibrant daily living and grand formal entertaining. This level features three spacious, bedrooms and a full bathroom. The grand living room serves as a stunning centerpiece, anchored by a fireplace and framed by exquisite stained-glass accents. Directly adjacent to the kitchen.

Your ideal lifestyle is available to you at The Arroyo at Baker Ranch in Lake Forest, CA. Enjoy the benefits of living in a home close to the city and the comfort of knowing that our community was planned with the resident's comfort and modern lifestyle in mind. You'll have easy access to a lively neighborhood as well as nearby dining, shopping, parks, and local events and entertainment. On free afternoons or weekends, visit Baker Ranch Community Park to explore the natural world right outside your front door. Make the most of our location near all the area has to offer. Start the day with Linda's Coffee House, finish it with Mustard Cafe & Grill Foothill Ranch or Caspian Mediterranean Kitchen, and then come home to The Arroyo at Baker Ranch, where you'll find plenty of space to call your own. Join our welcoming community and step into a life of ease today.

Nestled on a picturesque street along the coveted Northern slope of Bernal Heights, this single-family home presents an exceptional canvas to transform your vision into a dream home. Situated on an extra-wide lot with captivating views of the San Francisco skyline, this fixer property offers a rare combination of scale, setting, and potential. The existing home features three bedrooms, one bathroom, and a full size basement. Enjoy the quintessential Bernal Heights lifestyle with beloved cafs, restaurants, local shops, and everyday conveniences close at hand.

First showing: Friday, September 24 at 5:00-6:00 PM — reply to confirm.
This full-floor Victorian flat offers more than 1,500 square feet near Divisadero and Alamo Square, with high ceilings, bay windows, wood floors and original period details.
The layout includes three bedrooms and two adjoining front parlors. Pocket doors separate the parlors, each opens onto the hallway, and one has a closet. The flexible layout offers space for living and dining, or a home office while retaining a separate living room.
The eat-in kitchen has a dishwasher, plenty of cabinet space and room for a dining table. There is one full bathroom, a separate second toilet room and a large hallway storage closet. Windows along multiple sides of the flat bring in natural light.
Divisadero's cafes, restaurants and shops are around the corner, with The Mill, Nopa and Bi-Rite nearby. Alamo Square Park is a few blocks away. Nearby Muni service includes the 5/5R Fulton and 24 Divisadero.
